title: Disaster Records Are Becoming Routine: 28 In 2023
hook: America's disaster records are becoming ordinary.
closing: Repeated billion-dollar disasters push higher costs onto insurers, taxpayers, and households.
question: Have you lived through one?

segments.say: Billion-dollar disasters now average 20.4 yearly, turning rare catastrophes into events that arrive every few weeks.
The US recorded 28 billion-dollar disasters in 2023, making an exceptional year feel increasingly routine.
Billion-dollar disasters have cost about $2.6 trillion, spreading the bill across insurers, taxpayers, and households.
